en: Black‑and‑white view of a narrow medieval passageway between stone buildings. On the left is a large Gothic window with tall vertical panes and tracery, likely part of a church or chapel apse. A small patterned stained-glass panel is visible in one of the lower window sections. In the center is a pointed, arched stone gateway in a thick wall, leading to a tree‑lined path beyond. On the right is a smaller building with a tiled roof and shuttered windows. The path is cobbled or dirt, bordered by low stone walls and overgrown vegetation. There is no visible text on the image side.
